description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Krile (Fire)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Wind Drake's Back (0~2), removed after using Wind Drake's Back two times

description.name: Wind Drake's Back Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Wind Drake's Back level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Fire abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Krile (Fire)]

description.name: Wind Drake's Back Level
description.text: Keeps track of Wind Drake's Back level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Krile (Fire)]
